claim.claim-text: 1. Inhaler (1) with a respiration indicator (80), wherein the inhaler (1) has a chamber wall (82) forming a chamber (6) and a dispensing device (7) for fluidic connection of the chamber (6) to a body opening,

wherein the inhaler (1) has a discharge nozzle (2) for forming an aerosol (3) with a pharmaceutical agent preparation (4), wherein the respiration indicator (80) comprises a wall section (81) of the chamber wall (82) or is formed thereby, wherein the wall section (81) is flexible and configured to indicate a respiratory activity by deformation, wherein the chamber wall (82) is at least essentially dimensionally stable apart from the wall section (81) so as to be at least essentially unresponsive to respiratory activity, wherein the at least essentially dimensionally stable part of the chamber (6) has a through passage (88), which is sealed airtight by the wall section (81), and wherein

(i) the inhaler (1) is closed or designed to be airtight between an intake opening (85) of the chamber (6) and an outlet (10) of the dispensing device (7), and/or (ii) the respiration indicator (80) has an indicator means (84), which reacts to the deformation of the wall section (81) by changing the color or color intensity and/or changing the reflection or transmission properties relative to the visible light.

2. Inhaler according to Claim 1, wherein the chamber (6) comprises an intake opening (85) for receiving the aerosol (4) from the discharge nozzle (2) and/or wherein the dispensing device (7) comprises an outlet (10) from the chamber (6) for the aerosol (4).

3. Inhaler according to Claim 1 or 2, wherein the wall section (81) is deflectable into the chamber (6) from a rest position of the wall section (81) during inhalation and is deflectable outward relative to a surrounding portion of the chamber wall (82) during exhalation.

4. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the respiration indicator (80) is configured for indicating a pressure differential between the inside space and surrounding area of the chamber (6).

5. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the wall section (81) at least partially deflectable under the action of breathing in, out and/or through the chamber (6), preferably by material deformation, material expansion and/or by more than 1 mm, preferably more than 2 mm, in particular more than 3 mm, and/or less than 20 mm, preferably less than 15 mm, and in particular less than 10 mm.

6. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the wall section (81) is at least partially deformable in the shape of a vault or dome or curved in another way under the action of breathing in, out or through the chamber (6), preferably so that an apex or a peak (83) or a vault is formed, which is facing inside the space of the chamber (6) under the action of breathing out or through the chamber (6) and/or is facing away from the inside space of the chamber (6) under the action of breathing in the chamber (6).

7. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the wall section (81) is flat, flexible, deformable, curved, dome-shaped and/or membrane-like, in particular whereby the wall section (81) is adapted to occupy two stable states, in each of which the wall section (81) is curved.

8. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the wall section (81) is configured to turn or to change from a concave curvature into a convex curvature or vice versa, preferably under the action of breathing in, out or through the chamber (6) and/or by a pressure differential that acts on the wall section (81), in particular by more than 0.5 hPa, preferably more than 1 hPa, in particular more than 2 hPa, and/or less than 6 hPa, preferably less than 5 hPa, in particular less than 4 or 3 hPa.

9. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the chamber (6) is configured to generate underpressure and/or overpressure in the chamber (6) under the action of breathing in, out, or through the chamber (6), by which the wall section (81) can be deformed and/or moved.

10. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the wall section (81) is inserted or can be inserted into the chamber wall (82), preferably by friction, and/or so that the wall section (81) is connected snugly, in particular airtight or pressure-tight, to the chamber wall (82), sprayed, bonded, welded and/or clamped on the chamber wall (82).
11. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the wall section (81) and the chamber wall (82) have different materials and/or material thicknesses.

12. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the wall section (81) has a connecting means for fastening the wall section (81) in a through passage (70) of the chamber wall (82), preferably a frame (86) that forms a boundary of the wall section (81) with a contour that corresponds to a border of the through passage of the chamber wall (82).

13. Inhaler according to Claim 12, wherein the wall section (81) is configured for connection by positive-locking of the wall section (81) to the chamber wall (82), preferably wherein the wall section (81) encompasses a border of the through passage (70) of the chamber wall (82) or wherein the border of the through passage (70) of the chamber wall (82) encompasses the wall section (81).

14. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein in the position of use of the inhaler (1) the respiration indicator (80) is arranged upwardly and/or on the right relative to the main direction of flow under the action of breathing out or through the chamber (6).

15. Inhaler according to one of the preceding claims, wherein in the absence of a pressure differential between the inner and outer sides of the wall section (81), the wall section (81) is shaped to continue a surface line or contour line of the chamber wall (82) adjoining the wall section (81) and/or aligns with the chamber wall (82) adjoining the wall section (81), preferably so as to be essentially flush with portions of the chamber well adjoining the wall section.
